newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P affirms ACT ratings, rates yen/NZ$ issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P affirms ACT ratings, rates yen/NZ$ issue.

text.p: Standard and Poor's said it had affirmed its AAA long term and A-1 plus short term local currency ratings for the Australian Capital Territory (ACT).
The ratings outlook was stable for local currency debt, the agency said.
S&P also rated ACT's 6.5 billion yen dual currency issue, launched on November 7, at AA. The foreign currency rating outlook was positive, it added.
S&P said the rating on the samurai bond, the ACT's first cross-border issue, was constrained by the AA foreign currency sovereign rating of the Commonwealth of Australia.

The agency said the rating reflected the ACT's low debt burden, stable local economy, and conservative budgetary performance. This was supported by the Australian federal system and Canberra's place as the national capital.

S&P said these factors had enabled the ACT government to successfully absorb decreasing funding from the Commonwealth government without significantly weakening the ACT's financial profile. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373 1800
